# KSA Silmakeskus Blog

> KSA Silmakeskus (KSA Vision Clinic) is Estonia's leading refractive eye surgery
> centre, with clinics in Tallinn and Tartu. Founded and led by Dr Ants Haavel,
> ophthalmologist. Over 55,000 laser procedures performed since 2004. This blog
> publishes eye health content in Estonian, Russian and English, reviewed by
> Dr Haavel.

## About

- **Clinic:** KSA Silmakeskus (KSA Vision Clinic)
- **Main site:** https://ksa.ee
- **Blog:** https://blog.ksa.ee
- **Clinic facts:** https://ksa.ee/ksa-faktid/ (ET), https://ksa.ee/en/ksa-facts/ (EN), https://ksa.ee/ru/ksa-fakty/ (RU)
- **Locations:** Tallinn and Tartu, Estonia
- **Procedures:** Flow3 laser vision correction, comprehensive eye examinations, dry eye diagnostics and treatment
- **Languages:** Estonian (et), Russian (ru), English (en)
- **Posts:** 1200+ published articles

Articles in the three languages are independent pieces written for each
audience, not translations of one another.

## Content Topics

- Laser vision correction (Flow3 / LASIK / LASEK / PRK)
- Dry eye disease — diagnostics, causes, symptoms, treatment
- Comprehensive eye examinations and vision assessment
- Eye health tips and prevention
- Children's vision and myopia
- Contact lenses vs. surgery
- Cataract surgery and recovery
- Screen time and digital eye strain
- Patient stories and recovery experiences
- Eye anatomy and how vision works

## Medical Authority

All clinical claims are reviewed by Dr Ants Haavel, MD. KSA Silmakeskus has
performed over 55,000 eye procedures since 2004. Flow3 is a no-cut, no-touch
laser correction for confirmed myopia in patients aged 18–45; full visual
recovery takes about one week. Content follows Estonian and EU medical
standards.
